rules.note: DAY-NRLM definition: ₹1 lakh or more a year, over at least four agricultural seasons or business cycles, averaging over ₹10,000 a month

reason.en: Income is ₹1 lakh or more a year and has been sustained for {cycles_sustained} business cycles.
reason.hi: आमदनी साल में ₹1 लाख या उससे ज़्यादा है और {cycles_sustained} कारोबार-चक्र से लगातार बनी हुई है।

rules.note: Sustain income for the remaining cycles

reason.en: Income is above ₹1 lakh a year, but it has been sustained for {cycles_sustained} of the 4 required cycles.
reason.hi: आमदनी साल में ₹1 लाख से ऊपर है, पर ज़रूरी 4 में से अभी {cycles_sustained} चक्र ही पूरे हुए हैं।

reason.en: Income is {annual_income} a year: on the way, but below the Lakhpati line or its ₹10,000 monthly average.
reason.hi: आमदनी साल में {annual_income} है: राह पर हैं, पर अभी लखपति की सीमा या ₹10,000 महीने के औसत से नीचे।

reason.en: Income is {annual_income} a year, well below ₹1 lakh.
reason.hi: आमदनी साल में {annual_income} है, जो ₹1 लाख से काफ़ी कम है।

notes: Rule 1 follows the official definition. Rules 2 to 4 are simulation choices. A business cycle is six months and counts as sustained when its average monthly net income is above ₹10,000.
